description: This file implements a module for the lighttpd web server, specifically handling URL rewriting rules. It includes functions for initialization, configuration merging, parsing rewrite rules, and processing HTTP requests for both URI and physical file paths. The core logic involves applying regex-based rewrite rules to incoming requests to modify the request URI or physical paths accordingly.
